columns.name: setCode
columns.description: The set code of the set.

columns.name: num_cards
columns.description: The number of cards in the set, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_translations
columns.description: The number of translations of the card set, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_Japanese_translation_and_only_available_in_non_foil
columns.description: Set to 1 if the card set has Japanses translation and is only available non-foil.

columns.name: per_cards_with_a_converted_mana_cost_10
columns.description: The percentage of the cards with a converted Mana Cost of 10 in the set.

columns.name: card_has_highest_converted_mana_cost
columns.description: The name of card in the set with the highest converted mana cost, with ties broken by the ascending order of the card name
